capabilities: Read PDF and EPUB books in one reader
Explain, simplify, define, translate or ask about a selection
Keep highlights, notes and vocabulary linked to each book
Draw handwriting on PDF pages and on lined or blank paper
Track a book library with shelves, ratings and a reading goal
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat plugin; the AI actions work only on text selected inside a PDF or EPUB book.
extras: Free plugin; AI features need a chosen AI service whose own terms and prices apply. API keys are stored in plain text in the plugin settings. 'Open PDFs in this reader' uses an unofficial part of Obsidian to replace the built-in PDF viewer and is off by default. Beta builds are distributed through BRAT (Volland/book-companion-reader).
intentEvidence: This plugin brings that into Obsidian and goes further.
motivation: The author wanted e-reader-style word lookup inside Obsidian that goes further, explaining passages in context and turning reading into notes connected to the book.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in EPUB reader and its PDF viewer offers no way to attach highlights, notes, vocabulary or AI explanations to a book.

relations.evidence: Install it together with Typed Graph (recommended)
any deck can be saved as a note for the Spaced Repetition plugin

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI
Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter API key
Ollama or other OpenAI-compatible local server

summary: Book reader for PDF and EPUB with AI explanations, highlights, notes, vocabulary, handwriting and a library shelf system.
